title: Tawakoni Striper Guide
specs: Lake Tawakoni is one of the best Hybrid Striper fisheries in Texas
Fish species targeted include Hybrid Striper, White Bass, and Striped Bass
Trips include fish cleaning and filleting at no extra charge
Standard pricing covers up to four anglers per boat
Multiple boats available for larger groups
Corporate groups, family reunions, bachelor parties, church groups, youth outings welcome
includes: Fishing equipment and bait or lures

blurb: Guests fish for Hybrid Striper, White Bass, and Striped Bass on Lake Tawakoni using live bait or artificial lures. Trips are customized for beginners, families, and advanced anglers. Every trip includes fish cleaning, filleting, and bagging at no extra charge.
extraNote: Trips typically last about 4 hours, may vary with season and conditions · Booking recommended several weeks in advance, especially for peak season · Large groups accommodated with multiple boats · Guide adapts tactics daily to fish behavior and conditions · Tanglewood Marina, Lake Tawakoni · Year-round with peak season November through April
